description: This file provides a doubly linked list implementation with macros and inline functions for list manipulation, including list addition, deletion, replacement, splicing, and iteration, as well as support for hash list structures.

methods.name: INIT_LIST_HEAD
methods.description: Initializes a list head to point to itself, representing an empty list.

methods.name: __list_add
methods.description: Internal function to insert a new list element between two known consecutive entries.

methods.name: list_add
methods.description: Adds a new entry after the specified list head, useful for stack implementation.

methods.name: list_add_tail
methods.description: Adds a new entry before the specified list head, useful for queue implementation.

methods.name: __list_del
methods.description: Internal function to remove a list element by linking its previous and next elements.

methods.name: list_del
methods.description: Removes an element from the list, leaving it in an undefined state.

methods.name: list_replace
methods.description: Replaces an old list element with a new one.

methods.name: list_replace_init
methods.description: Replaces an old list element with a new one and reinitializes the old element.

methods.name: list_del_init
methods.description: Deletes an element from the list and reinitializes it.

methods.name: list_move
methods.description: Moves a list element to the head of another list.

methods.name: list_move_tail
methods.description: Moves a list element to the tail of another list.

methods.name: list_is_last
methods.description: Checks if a list element is the last in the list.

methods.name: list_empty
methods.description: Checks if a list is empty.

methods.name: list_empty_careful
methods.description: Checks if a list is empty and not being modified by other CPUs.

methods.name: __list_splice
methods.description: Internal function to join two lists.

methods.name: list_splice_init
methods.description: Joins two lists and reinitializes the source list.
